description: .NET CLI: Entity Framework drops and rollbacks, package publishing, new packages and tools, user secrets, and build and test commands.

rules.note: `ef database drop` drops the database. `ef database update 0` reverts every migration. `ef migrations remove --force` reverts the last migration in the database.
`nuget push` publishes a package. `nuget delete` unlists it.
`add package` adds a NuGet package. `tool install` installs a tool.
`user-secrets list` prints the secret values of the project.

safe.note: Build, test, format, restore from the project, and reads of migrations and packages. Tests are project code with a check contract. `dotnet run` and `dotnet watch` without `test` or `build` are not here: they run a program of the project with any effect (dev round 3).

writes.note: `dotnet ef database update` applies migrations to the database.
